annotations.title: Let people into the test copy

description: Changes who may open the app's pre, its private test copy (the developer always can). "add" lets in a Neblla account by email; "link" makes a password link for people without an account (the password is shown once); both wait in the app's queue until neblla_promote "save". "remove", "revoke" (a link) and "renewLocalKey" (owner only: the old localhost key stops working) act at once, but a pass already given lasts up to 4 hours. More: neblla_get_llms tools/pre_access

action.description: What to do. By action: add {email, expiresAt?}; link {password?, expiresAt?, label?}

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

email.description: add / remove: the Neblla account's email.

expiresAt.description: add / link: ISO date when it stops opening pre (left out: never).

label.description: link: a name for it, such as who it was sent to.

linkId.description: revoke: the link's id, from neblla_pre_access_read.

password.description: link: 6 to 128 characters; left out, one is generated.
